name: Climber Morwenna

intro.text: I've been up the Main Wall twice this morning. The limestone's polished like glass from a hundred years of climbers. Let's see if you've got grip.

win: Ah, I slipped. Not off the cliff, thankfully. Just off the pace.
after: Climbers have been on these walls since the 1890s. The goats have been on them longer.
